title: Large ideals in B(L1(0,1))
summary: We show that the norm-closed linear span of products of two Dunford-Pettis operators on $L^1(0,1)$ lies strictly between the representable and the Dunford-Pettis operators. This gives an additional proper large closed ideal in $\mathcal{B}(L^1(0,1))$, answering the existence question of Johnson, Pisier and Schechtman. The quotient of the Dunford-Pettis ideal by this square ideal contains a contractively complemented isometric copy of $L^1(0,1)$.
